interactive.label: Find Bursts
interactive.tooltip: Run the selected burst-detection algorithm over all included TTTR files.

interactive.label: Recompute
interactive.tooltip: Force a fresh burst search, ignoring cached results.

interactive.label: Save Bursts
interactive.tooltip: Save the detected bursts to .bur files next to the source data.

interactive.label: Add Files
interactive.tooltip: Open a dialog to add TTTR measurement files.

interactive.label: Add Folder
interactive.tooltip: Open a dialog to add a folder of TTTR files.

interactive.label: to ndX
interactive.tooltip: Send the current burst selection to ndXplorer.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Start a step-by-step guided tour of burst selection.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Open the help window with reference documentation.

interactive.label: filter_alg
interactive.tooltip: Burst-detection algorithm: sliding window, CUSUM/SPRT, Kalman, BOCPD, coincident, max-tree, or Bayesian Blocks.

interactive.label: ch_sel
interactive.tooltip: Detector channel (or All) whose photons are used for the burst search.

interactive.label: win_sel
interactive.tooltip: PIE/micro-time window (or All) whose photons are used for the burst search.

interactive.label: min_photons
interactive.tooltip: Minimum photons a burst must have; the size cut is applied after the search.

interactive.label: photon_window
interactive.tooltip: Consecutive photons m required inside the time window to call a burst.

interactive.label: time_window
interactive.tooltip: Sliding window duration T in milliseconds.

interactive.label: Use min dMT
interactive.tooltip: Reject photon pairs with a macro-time interval Δt below the minimum.

interactive.label: Use max dMT
interactive.tooltip: Reject photon pairs with a macro-time interval Δt above the maximum.

interactive.label: ms
interactive.tooltip: Maximum Δt between photons in milliseconds.

interactive.label: merge_gap
interactive.tooltip: Merge bursts separated by fewer than this many photons.

interactive.label: threshold_khz
interactive.tooltip: Count-rate cutoff in kHz used to separate bursts from background.

interactive.label: Subtract Background
interactive.tooltip: Subtract the background count rate from the burst photon counts.

interactive.label: All Photons
interactive.tooltip: Show all photons in the diagnostic plots.

interactive.label: Selected Bursts
interactive.tooltip: Show only photons inside detected bursts in the diagnostic plots.

interactive.label: Bin (ms)
interactive.tooltip: Bin width of the macro-time count-rate trace in milliseconds.

interactive.label: X Feature
interactive.tooltip: Burst feature plotted on the X axis of the 2D scatter.

interactive.label: Y Feature
interactive.tooltip: Burst feature plotted on the Y axis of the 2D scatter.

interactive.label: Static FRET Line
interactive.tooltip: Overlay the static FRET line at S = 0.5 on the E–S scatter.
